plate exchange: doors open, plate up 8 mm
doors open, reservoir and drawer out
module swap: arm released, module dropped

sweeps.note: blade from park to end of spread
build piston: stroke, bottom stop and +8 mm plate-exchange overtravel
drop-down door about its bottom hinge
reservoir slides out to the front
cover-slide drawer pulls out of the lid's front edge
Z arm drops away from the rod end (magnet breaks away), piston held by its collar
build module drops 22 mm out of the floor port, slides forward under the chamber, lifts over the guard sill and out
